target_customer: Contractors and small businesses in the US that must buy surety bonds for licensing or public work
problem: Buying a surety bond means slow paperwork and opaque pricing from agents; businesses want instant online quotes.
business_model: Insurance broker earning commissions on surety bonds sold online

founders.name: Bruce Chi
education: Studied economics in college; school not listed
previous_startups: Led offshore engineers building an Upwork competitor for graphic design (outcome not stated)
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: McKinsey consultant and Indeed product manager.

founders.name: Jay Xiao
founders.background_notes: YC page lists no background. Listed as co-founder on the YC page (https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/suretynow).

technical_complexity.rationale: A quoting and application front end over carrier and bond-form data; the hard part is carrier integrations and licensing, not software research.

defensibility.rationale: Brokerage licenses and carrier appointments are a modest barrier, but many online bond agencies already existed and the product is copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbent brokers consolidated through acquisitions by larger brokers (for example EPIC buying Bond Exchange), but no source shows SuretyNow being copied or bought.

market_need_then: The company cites an 8 billion dollar US surety opportunity and a regulatory requirement for bonds on public contracts; the figure is the company's own claim.

branding.domain_note: Uses suretynow.com exact match; the site is copyrighted to Nomad Insurance Agency Inc.
branding.community_and_virality: Only Trustpilot review pages found; no press about the brand.

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive name conveying speed, with no press, mascot or community found.

outcome_analysis: SuretyNow is an active brokerage in the 2024 YC batch with about 20 staff per YC. It targets a niche where speed and online quoting are the wedge. No funding amount beyond aggregator claims, no exit and no shutdown were found, so the outcome is undetermined and the record rests mostly on the YC page.
notes: Funding unverified: aggregators (CB Insights, VCBacked, FundedIQ) list about 500K pre-seed from Y Combinator in April 2024; one lists 950K across three rounds; no press release found. No competitor source dated near the batch was found (only undated aggregator pages), so the list is empty. YC page says team 20 while an aggregator says 4. Completeness pass: the 500K pre-seed (April 2024, YC) is recorded from VCBacked and CB Insights (FundedIQ also; Employbl shows a separate 450K entry); aggregators only, may be the standard YC deal. Jay Xiao is listed as co-founder on the YC page.
